fade.title: Fade smoothness and curve
fade.description: Smoothness sets how often the light gets a new level during a fade: Fine sends a command for every level step (smoothest, most commands); Medium (the default) and coarser settings send fewer, slightly bigger steps. The Natural curve makes sunrises and sunsets look even to the eye.

power.title: Power limit
power.description:
The app never lets the light's total power go above 100 % (R counts 39 %, G 41 %, B 53 %, UV 11 % at full). With all channels at 100 % the light would draw 144 %, which can overheat the LEDs and power supply. With the limit on, anything above 100 % is scaled down proportionally (same colors, a bit dimmer), and single channel sliders refuse changes that would exceed it, like the app.

Only turn this off if you know your light can handle it.
